import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# Average several perception samples to reduce ~1cm noise
def avg_pose(fn, name, n=8):
    ps, qs = [], []
    for _ in range(n):
        p, q = fn(name)
        ps.append(p); qs.append(q)
    p = np.mean(ps, axis=0)
    # average quaternions (sign-align to first)
    qs = np.array(qs)
    for i in range(1, len(qs)):
        if np.dot(qs[0], qs[i]) < 0:
            qs[i] = -qs[i]
    q = np.mean(qs, axis=0); q /= np.linalg.norm(q)
    return p, q

# Perceive nut center, handle grasp pose, and peg pose
nut_pos, nut_quat = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = avg_pose(sample_grasp_pose, "extruded handle of the brown square nut")
peg_pos, peg_quat = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "brown square block")

# Fixed rigid offset from nut center to handle grasp (world frame, nut not rotated during transport)
offset = grasp_pos - nut_pos

# Grasp the handle
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift
lift_pos = grasp_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.15])
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Target: nut center above the peg, so EE goes to peg + offset (keep same orientation)
insert_height = peg_pos[2] + 0.02  # slightly above block base so nut slides onto peg
target_pos = np.array([peg_pos[0] + offset[0], peg_pos[1] + offset[1], insert_height + offset[2] - nut_pos[2] + nut_pos[2]])
target_pos = np.array([peg_pos[0], peg_pos[1], insert_height]) + offset

# Move above the peg, then descend with approach for insertion
goto_pose(target_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.15]), grasp_quat)
goto_pose(target_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.12)

# Release and retreat
open_gripper()
goto_pose(target_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.15]), grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
